item.title: FRINGE: Rob Carlton returns to the Fringe with Virgin in a Knife Fight
item.description: Award-winning actor and storyteller Rob Carlton returns to Adelaide Fringe with Virgin in a Knife Fight, a brand new live show packed with true stories, sharp turns and laugh-out-loud moments — from a Salzburg street standoff to a humbling moment of fatherhood.

item.title: From candles to highland cattle, McLaren Vale’s viral ‘Scones With The Cows’ experience is winning hearts
item.description: What started as a candle business has evolved into one of McLaren Vale’s most delightful experiences. The viral ‘Scones With The Cows’ is combining Highland cattle, fresh baking and country charm into a must-do escape.

item.title: Paper Tiger roars back to Rundle Street with bold Malaysian and Indonesian flavours, and late-night cocktail bar vibes
item.description: After months of rebuilding, Paper Tiger has officially returned to Rundle Street with an elevated menu, indulgent share plates and a fresh late-night cocktail offering.

item.title: Wheelchair user puts Adelaide Aquatic Centre to the test and the verdict is in
item.description: Disability advocate Shane Hryhorec says Adelaide’s new Aquatic Centre ranks among the best he’s ever experienced.

item.title: FIRST LOOK: Get Lickd is the new Torrensville coffee spot offering pistachio puppys, iced Biscoff lattes and skittle bombs
item.description: Lickd Cafe has quietly popped up in Torrensville with dessert-style caffeine served in cans and a cheeky sense of humour that’s already drawing crowds to its tiny hole-in-the-wall window.

item.title: Marrabel Coffee Shop opens keeping beloved regional general store in family for 75 years
item.description: After decades as a private home, a historic Marrabel shopfront reopens as a coffee shop, bringing 75 years of family history back to the main street.

item.title: COMING SOON: Bar Pin brings seasonal small plates, local wine bar energy, and a leafy fig-tree courtyard to Adelaide’s inner west
item.description: A new neighbourhood bar is taking shape in Adelaide’s inner west, with Bar Pin set to bring Euro-style small plates, local wine and a leafy fig-tree courtyard in early 2026.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Thursday January 29th and the days ahead
item.description: Here's the weather for January 29th and a look at what's to come over the weekend.

item.title: Vodafone outage impacts calls to SA Police assistance line
item.description: RESOLVED: South Australia Police is urgently investigating a technical issue preventing Vodafone users from reaching 131 444.

item.title: Experienced community services leader Daniel Cox named new CEO of Guide Dogs SA/NT
item.description: Guide Dogs SA/NT has appointed experienced health and community services leader Daniel Cox as its new CEO, commencing in February 2026.
